resources.string: My external Host
Configure your own host, explicitly choose a source, then read directly; disabled by default

This is your own Suwayomi 2.4 host, not an app-operated manga platform. Saving or enabling a configuration never connects. Reading requires a separate grant lasting 15 minutes in this process; usernames and passwords are not saved or synced. Online reading needs your Host, but not the Desktop client. Temporary cache is not an offline download. An explicitly saved chapter enters the local library only after complete validation, then no longer needs the Host.
